U_0x013705:
A super robot Dr. Kisaburo Azuma built on commission from a certain company, before he met Compatible Kaiser. Officially "Bankaran," it became "G Bankaran" when Michiru Hanaten added the "G."
A melee-focused power fighter, its heavy armor and rugged frame make it durable, and joints refined with Compatible Kaiser know-how let the heavyweight move nimbly. Its look mirrors a young Kisaburo, who meant to pilot it himself if needed.
U_0x013A76:
A special humanoid mobile weapon for sword combat. Its Direct Feedback System sends the pilot's thoughts straight to the machine, and it wields slashing arms like the "Five Great Blades." The mantle is a shield that can even deflect beams.
Likely developed alongside Soulgain, it shares parts but lacks the pilot-uniting Direct Action Link System. Its response trails Soulgain's, yet stronger thrusters give it a higher top speed.
U_0x013DB3:
A special close-combat humanoid mobile weapon piloted by Axel Almar. Its Direct Action Link System syncs the machine to the pilot's movements; with the Direct Feedback System and ABMD (artificial skeletal-muscle drive), it gains superb response and mobility. Liquid-metal blades in both elbows work with its fists for strong melee power.
Most of its armor is EG alloy, a shape-recovering active metal, so it partly self-repairs battle damage.
U_0x014101:
A humanoid assault weapon of the "Assault Dragoon" category. It records the pilot's brainwave patterns, then semi-forcibly syncs via machine feedback, turning reflexes directly into commands for patterned operations.
Remote flying gun turrets called Sword Breakers mount on both shoulders, favoring mid-long range. A commander's unit; several sister units exist.
U_0x0143D2:
A special humanoid mobile weapon piloted by Lamia Loveless. Near-organic wings and feminine armor lend it a mystical air. Its arms - energy shaped into lances or arrows, plus a slim rapier - evoke a Western knight, yet its materials and power source are unknown; it likely uses <EOT>.
<Isurugi Heavy Ind.> reputedly built it for the Federation's next mainline unit trials, though unproven. Its registry bars all but its set pilot, Lamia.
U_0x0146F7:
A humanoid mobile weapon for ground and artillery combat, also called Type 34. This custom unit grafts its successor's drivetrain and generator into the mass-produced RGV-Type 30 "Randgrith" to boost firepower and armor, with heavy plating, a shield, jammer, and beam coating.
The Rathgrith Raven adds a flight unit/armed base with a <Tesla Drive> and plasma generator, letting it fly under gravity, plus a focused charged-particle cannon.
